plan.notes: Official Utah Tech University 2025-2026 Catalog, Mechatronics BS graduation plan text PDF. Semester totals as printed: 15 / 14 / 14 / 16 / 15 / 16 / 15 / 16 = 121, matching the printed 'Total Hours 121'. Lecture+lab pairs printed on combined rows (e.g., 'MTRN 2300 & MTRN 2305' = 4 credits) are modeled as single combined entries per the source's own hour groupings. Course titles verified against the 2025-2026 catalog: ENGR 2050 Fundamentals of Engineering Mathematics; MECH 1000 Introduction to Design & Rapid Prototyping; MECH 1100 Manufacturing Processes; MECH 1150 Prototyping Techniques; MECH 1200 Coding; MECH 2010 Statics; MECH 2210 Circuits; MECH 2250 Sensors & Actuators; MTRN 2200 Industrial Wiring for Automated Systems; MTRN 2300 Introduction to Programmable Logic Controllers; MTRN 2350 Advanced PLC Programming and Applications; MTRN 2400 Mechanical Components; MTRN 3360 Industrial Robots; MTRN 3400 Fluid Power Systems; MTRN 3500 Motion Control in Mechatronic Systems; MTRN 3560 Industrial Motor Controls; MTRN 3600 Industrial Networks; MTRN 4000 Product Design I; MTRN 4010 Product Design II; MTRN 4600 Advanced Mechatronic System Design; MTRN 4700 Semiconductors and Mechatronics; PHYS 2010 College Physics I (PS); PHYS 2020 College Physics II; MATH 1080 Pre-Calculus with Trigonometry (MA); ENGL 1010 Introduction to Writing (EN); ENGL 2010 Interm Writing Selected Topics: (EN). 'Tech Elective' slots (numbered 1-4) are choice placeholders; catalog: complete 9 credits from any MTRN 4xxx (excl. 4000, 4010, 4500, 4505, 4600, 4605, 4700), any MECH 4xxx (excl. 4000, 4010), any ECE 4xxx (excl. 4000, 4005, 4010, 4015); max 3 cr from research/design practicum; Engineering Department approval required for other courses. Prerequisites not populated from the plan; see official course descriptions in the 2025-2026 catalog.
